_about: Staff notes on getting there. Written by hand, kept short, corrected by the Captain as he goes. Keyed by venue id (slug of the venue name).
avon-cinema: Thayer St — walkable from the house; street parking on Thayer is scarce on weekend evenings, the side streets are easier.
the-vets: 1 Avenue of the Arts, by the State House. Convention Center and nearby garages; a 10-minute walk from Kennedy Plaza (RIPTA).
providence-performing-arts-center: 220 Weybosset St, downtown. Several garages within two blocks; arrive 30 min early for Broadway nights.
dowling-theater: Trinity Rep, 201 Washington St, downtown. Trinity has a parking garage alongside; also street and nearby lots.
trinity-repertory-company: 201 Washington St, downtown. Trinity has a parking garage alongside; also street and nearby lots.
the-strand-ballroom-theatre: 79 Washington St, downtown. General-admission floor; doors usually an hour before the show.
amica-mutual-pavilion: 1 La Salle Square, downtown. Convention Center garage is attached; Kennedy Plaza is a short walk.
greenwich-odeum: 59 Main St, East Greenwich — about 25 minutes by car. Small room, every seat is close; Main St parking and the lots behind.
comedy-connection: 39 Warren Ave, East Providence — about 10 minutes by car; free lot on site.
the-met: 1005 Main St, Pawtucket (Hope Artiste Village) — about 10 minutes by car; free lot.
fete-music-hall: 103 Dike St, Olneyville — 10 minutes by car; street parking.
as220: 115 Empire St, downtown. Street parking and the Westminster lots.
alchemy: 71 Richmond St, downtown — street parking; late shows, 18+ or 21+ by night.
stadium-theatre: 28 Monument Sq, Woonsocket — about 35 minutes by car; free municipal lots around the square.
waterfire-providence: Waterplace Park and the rivers downtown. Garages fill early on lighting nights; walking in from College Hill is the easy way.
providence-athenaeum: 251 Benefit St — a walk from the house.
pizzitola-sports-center: Brown athletics, Hope St — walkable from the house.
meehan-auditorium: Brown hockey, Hope St — walkable from the house.
stevenson-pincince-field: Brown soccer, Elmgrove Ave — walkable from the house.
newport-classical: Concert venues vary (Rosecliff, Emmanuel Church, the Recital Hall); Newport is about 45 minutes by car — allow more on summer weekends.
